description: Header file defining a ThreadPool class with nested interfaces, job management, scheduling, and worker thread implementations for a multi-threaded task execution system.

classes.name: ThreadPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, job scheduling, and execution with support for priorities, monitoring, and callbacks.

classes.name: ThreadPool::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback when the thread pool is idle.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IJob
classes.description: Interface representing a job that can be resubmitted.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IScheduler
classes.description: Interface for scheduling jobs at specific times.

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for initializing, deinitializing, and dispatching jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Metadata
classes.description: Structure holding metadata about worker threads and jobs.

classes.name: ThreadPool::DispatchedJobMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for monitoring dispatched jobs (warning reporting enabled).

classes.name: ThreadPool::IDispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring dispatched jobs (warning reporting enabled).

classes.name: ThreadPool::JobType
classes.description: Template class representing a job with internal state management and resubmission logic.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Minion
classes.description: Represents a worker entity that processes jobs from the queue.

classes.name: ThreadPool::Executor
classes.description: Thread class that runs a Minion instance.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Count
methods.description: Returns the number of worker threads.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending jobs in the queue.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current worker and job statuses.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of a specific worker thread.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the queue, optionally with priority.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Revoke
methods.description: Attempts to revoke a job from execution or queue.

methods.name: ThreadPool::WaitForStop
methods.description: Waits for all worker threads to stop.

methods.name: ThreadPool::HasThreadID
methods.description: Checks if a thread ID belongs to a worker thread.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Announce
methods.description: Registers a thread ID as active.

methods.name: ThreadPool::SetDispatchedJobMonitor
methods.description: Sets the monitor for dispatched jobs.

methods.name: ThreadPool::Idle
methods.description: Checks if the thread pool is idle and triggers callback.
